incidence_grid.selection_rule: among cells passing every outcome-free support gate, maximize share quantile, then flow quantile, then lead-shock quantile
incidence_grid.strictest_flow_0_85_failure: every share=0.90/flow=0.85 cell fails the fixed 2022H1 minimum-12 support floor; no return selected the fallback

mechanism.claim: a sustained rise in next-quarter contract share accompanied by accepted next-contract aggressor flow and a next-over-front price shock can relay into the common BTC perpetual after the completed path
mechanism.why_not_prior_roll_repair: the rejected roll policy used one completed bar, pressure times sqrt(volume), and a 60m continuation on the next COIN-M contract. CMSR uses a 24-bar path transition, raw normalized flow, pair-local nonoverlapping 30d ranks, relative price-shock leadership, delayed BTCUSDT execution, and a fixed 3h relay horizon
mechanism.why_not_ccpr: CMSR uses dated COIN-M front/next volume, flow, and completed price paths; it uses no USD-M/COIN-M perpetual OI or taker-ratio gap

source_contract.gap_policy: all 24 current path rows must be valid, exact-grid, and retain the same front/next pair; no fill, promotion, or stale carry

causal_feature_contract.current_path: 24 completed five-minute rows ending at signal bar t
causal_feature_contract.strict_prior_thresholds: pair-local rolling quantiles over 8,640 prior anchors with at least 6,000 valid values; the series is shifted 24 bars so no reference feature path overlaps the current 24-bar path
causal_feature_contract.setup: share_slope>=prior_q90; abs(next_flow)>=prior_q80; abs(lead_shock)>=prior_q80; sign(next_flow)=sign(next_return)=sign(lead_shock)!=0; abs(front_return)<=0.60*abs(next_return); only a false-to-true transition within the same pair may signal

execution_contract.feature_available: signal bar t closes at t+5m
execution_contract.entry: leave one complete 5m bucket empty; enter at signal open t+10m
execution_contract.delivery_safety: at signal t both contracts must retain at least the 12h buffer plus the 3h hold and 10m signal-to-entry latency before delivery
execution_contract.nonoverlap: one global BTCUSDT position reserved over [entry, exit)
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM, entry cost, every held favorable-then-adverse 5m OHLC path, conservative funding boundaries, virtual adverse-mark exit cost, and actual exit cost
execution_contract.cagr: full declared calendar including every idle second

falsification_controls.no_share_transition: retain accepted flow and lead-shock gates only
falsification_controls.no_lead_shock: retain share transition and accepted-flow gates only
falsification_controls.front_led_mirror: swap front/next roles in share, flow, accepted return, and lead shock
falsification_controls.direction_flip: same CMSR entries with side multiplied by -1
falsification_controls.extra_latency_1h: same signal and side, entry and exit delayed 12 bars

rejection_contract.support_failure: reject without opening BTCUSDT execution outcomes
rejection_contract.train_failure: reject and keep 2023 BTCUSDT outcomes sealed
rejection_contract.test_failure: reject without direction threshold feature timing or hold repair
rejection_contract.2024_plus: remain sealed until unchanged train and test pass; a later source extension must be separately checksum-frozen

rllm_boundary.future_role: after deterministic passage, an LLM may explain the multi-bar state or abstain under a separately frozen policy
